messages:
Maya (People Ops): All-hands in 18m. Tiny thread for final run checks, speaker order, and recording fallbacks. Green room 14:05. Who needs a slide-swap?
Olivia (AV): Bringing camera A + B, switcher, and dongles. Phone hotspot is charged if office wifi flutters. I'll set OBS to record local + stream.
Diego (Eng): Quick note: if the laptop CPU goes above 75% the GPU encoder will take over. Also close Chrome tabs to avoid accidental notifications.
Priya (Product): Can we swap "Metrics" and "Roadmap"? Want metrics first to set stage.
Maya (People Ops): Swapped. New order pushed to slide deck TOC.
Sam (CEO): Good. Keep slides concise so we have 15m for audience Q.
Zoe (SRE): Recording fallback plan: local SSD -> internal S3 -> public bucket. Rsync snippet for after show: `rsync -av /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1795012345.mp4 gs://redwood-recordings/`
Olivia (AV): CaptionBot live is on. If confidence drops I'll overlay prepped VTT. Bring wired headset as backup.
CaptionBot: Captions active  latency ~1.8s  confidence 0.90.
Diego (Eng): Small troubleshooting tip: if you see duplicated audio processes run `pkill -f ffmpeg` then restart OBS recording.
Maya (People Ops): Stage manager (Olivia) will cue speakers. Please stay muted until cue and say a quick "ready" in green room.
Priya (Product): Post-meeting: product will collect top 4 roadmap questions and assign owners within 48h.
Olivia (AV): If main stream drops I'll post `:warning: main ingest down, switching to hotspot` and flip to backup.
RecordingBot: Recording started  writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1795012345/live.mp4
Sam (CEO): Quick ask to folks asking questions: mark if it's sensitive (customer/pricing) so we can triage with legal.
Maya (People Ops): Final reminder: green room 14:05, presenters please test mic for 10s. Follow-up notes posted to #all-hands within 2 hours. Good luck! :sparkles:
